messages.displayText:
I aim to be the kind of Trainer who can support
Pokémon that want to get stronger.

Practically everyone has a Pokémon now. Means
you’ve gotta step up your game to get noticed.

It’s rough living out of a hotel for a long time, so
I want to pick a nice one. But those nightly rates<U+0010><U+0001>븀
at Hotel Richissime are no joke...

I’m so glad I have my Pokémon. My life would be
empty without them.
That way of talking is quite popular these days.

I watched one of those Canari videos. My word,
what a sharp tongue!

The Rouge District feels like the true crème de la
crème of Lumiose, wouldn’t you say?

I’m searching for stragglers from a no-good
organization called Team Flare.

Once I win the Z-A Royale, I’ll make everyone in
this city wear a furisode like me!

I’m very particular about my jogging shoes.
Fashion starts from the feet, you know!

Sir, please refrain from
bodybuilding out here.

But how else am I gonna
get as buff as Machoke?

This city’s like a maze at night,
so I stick to daytime deliveries.

All you gotta do in the Z-A
Royale is win, win, win!

Wonder if we could
get Mega Rings...

It’s too darn hard for kids
to join the Z-A Royale!

Fifty years isn’t that old for
a building in Lumiose! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Pain au chocolat?
Or chocolatine?

I wonder who decided what
each flower symbolizes... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I think some Pokémon have
been snacking on my wares... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I wonder which flowers are the
most popular among Pokémon. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Tell people you appreciate
them before they’re gone. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You can withstand any hardship
as long as you have some bread!

A lot more people are buying fruit
for their Pokémon these days. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

If Florges had a favorite flower
shop, it would be this one! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

One of my regulars has a
left-handed Pokémon. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

It’s said Kalos’s history spans
over three thousand years! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I’m going to bake bread that
every Pokémon will want to try.

Crêpes came from
galettes, you know. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Flowers wither as
soon as they bloom... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Do Pokémon make their own
trails in Lumiose City, I wonder?

It must be so comfy
inside a Poké Ball!

Surely Pokémon like being
by their Trainer’s side best!

Can I let you in on a little secret? The truth is that
I’m the strongest Trainer in town...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I don’t battle, so no one will ever know!

I’m not fussed about exchanging my Mega
Shards, but I do like collecting them.

If you can’t give 100 percent during practice, how
can you expect to give 110 percent in a battle?

I tell my Pokémon all the
things I can’t say to her.

In the end, we hash things
out through Pokémon battles.

Some things are the right thing to
do, even if they’re not normal.

I’ll knock out a ton of Mable’s
research tasks while I sightsee!

TMs can’t be used
on people...right?

I bring my best Pokémon with me so everyone will
know what a big shot I am.

That way of thinking only reveals just how small-
minded he is.
I wanna be Detective Emma’s apprentice.
We could be the Lumiose Junior Detectives!
That Espurr, Mimi, won’t make it easy, though...

I don’t have time to waste on
things I don’t want to do!

The folks living here always
order the same things.

We eat and drink, then battle
our ideas and our Pokémon.

Living in this city could get difficult for folks who
don’t like Pokémon.

I’m on litter pickup duty every
day. Rust Syndicate’s orders.

So a “passage” over here
means a shopping mall?

If I put clothes on my Fire-type
Pokémon, would they burn off?

The Rouge District passage has the best selection
when it comes to clothing!

Buying out the whole store is an option, but then
I’d still have to choose what to wear.

I’m shopping for clothes that will complement
my Pokémon when we go out strolling together.

I’m here looking for clothes that will make me
look like a tougher opponent.

Perhaps I’ll go with a simple silhouette and dress
it up with accessories.

Everyone’s got secrets.
Pokémon and people, too.

Even if you don’t need anything,
it’s fun going around the shops.

It’s hard to pick clothes that’ll
look good on others, isn’t it?

I want to get my Pokémon
something cute to wear.

Online shoppers depend on folks
like us to bring fashion to them!

With so many options, it’s hard to know what
would look good on me...

I’m looking for inconspicuous clothing to wear for
the Z-A Royale.

After countless Z-A Royale losses, I’ve decided to
treat myself to some retail therapy.

Seriously?! I can’t believe I got
left behind in this battle zone...

My big sis is so close with her Pokémon.
Honestly, I’m pretty jealous...

It’s natural to grow close to your Pokémon when
you sit on a bench and hang out with them.

I play the kindly old man by day, but I show my
true face at night as a Trainer in the Z-A Royale!

While making deliveries, I try to pick up feathers
and stuff on the ground to keep Lumiose pristine.

I can’t throw a battle, no matter what’s at stake!
Client, business partner—it doesn’t matter!

For our next destination, how about heading to
Galar to do some Dynamaxing?

Nice idea! We can go
to the Battle Tower!

When I’m given two options,
I always want to choose both.

I still go out and catch Pokémon—
my age is no good reason not to!

The rooftops on either side of us are a bit higher
than here...but anyone can climb up to ’em!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
All you gotta do is hold <U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0007>Stick_L in the direction you
wanna go!

Hey, you climbed up to that rooftop no problem!
My bro’s a parkour pro—I bet he was impressed!

Climb on up here! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I saw how nimble you were, climbing up here...
Extraordinary! I can tell you’re something special!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Thanks for showing me some great climbing.
Here, take these as a little show of appreciation!

The trick to climbing up onto more rooftops is to
make your way through the scaffolding courses!

There’s too much tasty food here!
I dunno if I’ll ever leave Lumiose!

We tend to pick our favorite
Pokémon to be our partners.

Do you ever wonder if the Berries found on the
ground all over town are leftovers from Pokémon?

I saw a video of this special curry they serve at
Hotel Z that looks totally insane.

People only ever come talk to me
because they like my Pokémon.

If you’re here for a battle, I’ll have to pass. I don’t
wanna mess up my partner’s fur.

The better the people and Pokémon in a town are
doing, the more interesting it is to stroll around.

Just having my Pokémon
around me lifts my spirits!

Scraping by on Pokémon
battling alone is a tough life.

I always just panic and throw the first ball I grab,
so I keep on using regular old Poké Balls.

I’ve been working on my dashing so I can always
outrun Pokémon!

Diantha’s debut performance on the silver screen
as a young girl was truly wonderful.

To be seen as refined, one must dine in a refined
manner and speak with a refined vocabulary.

Is it safe to try petting
Poison-type Pokémon?

Aw, gotta find another way to
school ’cause of Pokémon...

One day, I’m gonna become a
Trainer worthy of my Pokémon!

Maybe the reason Pokémon can’t use a move as
soon as they’re sent into battle is because they<U+0010><U+0001>븀
need a moment to check their surroundings.

I wonder if the different kinds of Poké Balls are
more or less comfortable for Pokémon to be in?

Do you think wild Pokémon
ever hope they’ll get caught?

I go jogging to explore the city and look for spots
that I can use to my advantage in the Z-A Royale.

Why not just go
right in and ask?

I’ll check my Rotom Phone to see
if we can make a reservation here.

Looking up all the time just makes my neck hurt.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Though looking to the side makes me wonder if
I’m falling behind my peers...

Sometimes forfeiting is the
right call in the Z-A Royale.

Certain Pokémon only
appear at night, of course.

Detective Emma is incredible.
How does she do all of that?

Lumiose is in the center of Kalos
and has a tower at its own center.

The Lumiose Gang is
always there for Emma!

Emma’s partner can use
some crazy cool telepathy!

Another day of being woken by
a Pokémon move to the face...

I’m a member of the Pokédex Research Society.
If I could write Helioptile’s Pokédex entry, I’d say:<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“Since Helioptile can change light from the sun
into electrical energy, it can function just fine<U+0010><U+0001>븀
even without eating food.”

I heard once that Ivor lost to a certain girl when
he was young. Apparently that defeat is what led<U+0010><U+0001>븀
him to start learning martial arts.

What kinds of dreams do you think our Pokémon
have, all tucked away in their Poké Balls?

We couriers train our partner Pokémon so we can
protect our deliveries while we’re out and about!

I’m a warrior on a journey of growth, traveling the
world in the guise of a common tourist.

We’ve visited many different places in our travels.
And mostly just lost to many different Trainers...

Watching videos of others battling
is a good way to learn the basics.

I lost to my Pokémon
in an eating contest!

Do you think Pokémon remember their own
Evolution?

Whether it’s in art or in Pokémon battles, we all
start out as novices.

Emma’s mentor was a detective
who went by the name of Looker.
The Rock type is strong against Fire types, right?
The Fire type is strong against Steel types.

And the Steel type is strong against Rock types...
It’s vital that you build yourself a balanced team!

I don’t actually like to join battles,
but I sure do like watching them!

I just can’t catch up with some
of these Trainers who go all out.

My favorite type is the good ol’
Normal type! So few weaknesses!

Ground types may have a lot of
weaknesses, but I like them best.
Meditite gives off megapowerful vibes, right?
More like meditative vibes, no?

I love dishes with Slowpoke tail!
It’s really sweet—did you know?

Cheese made from Skiddo
milk is suuuper yummy!

I heard Emma was mentored by an
officer of the International Police.

There’s a kid in my class
battling in the Z-A Royale!

Lock on, and then go on the attack!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Throw a ball as soon as that catch window opens!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s helpful to imagine it all playing out in your
head before doing the real thing, right?

Messing about in wild zones may be fine for you,
but are you sure your Pokémon feel the same?

I know there are things to be gained from defeat...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I still don’t want to lose to another Trainer!
And I don’t want to see my Pokémon lose either!

How can I win?
Is it all about levels?!

And what’s a
“base point”?

All you need to get strong is to
keep on loving your Pokémon!

Do you hafta know
the popular moves?

Have you ever seen the exact moment a Mega
Crystal forms?
What’re those Mega Crystals even made of?

Growing up alongside Pokémon...
It’s not as common as you’d think.

My partner Pokémon’s been in
my family longer than I have!

I’d like to set up some classrooms
where we can send out Pokémon...

The poor Pokémon are stuck
in their balls all schoolday!

But if we sent ’em out,
I’d just wanna battle.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me! And I’m one of the
strongest in my class!

I’m not letting you walk back home alone until
you can defeat me in a battle.

I’ve got after-school activities with
my Pokémon once I get home.

Pokémon battles are all I
think about, day or night.

Pokémon are life, that’s for sure.
But life’s also full of surprises.

I think I know what you mean—
but I’m also pretty sure I don’t.
n/a
n/a

Hard bread! Get your
real hard bread here!

I wanna eat everything! Please, please, can’t I
have some more pocket money?

I suppose so, since we’re here to shop anyway.
But get something for your Pokémon too!

Please have a look! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I simply adore une
marché traditionnel!

I travel all around the world’s regions and write
up posts on the great food I find in each.

Do you call the end of a baguette “le croûton” or
“le quignon”? My friend and I can’t agree!
They’re delicious!

My job’s to gently shoo away the Pokémon that
come sniffing around for something to eat.

Even if the Pokémon I shoo away keep coming
back, I just gently shoo them away again.

The only thing that’s changed recently that I can
think of is all this “urban redevelopment” bunk...

Lumiose is surrounded by so much nature! Why
do these Pokémon keep gathering in our streets?

When I send out my partner Pokémon, wild
Pokémon are more likely to react...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But that also means they’re more likely to attack
my partner...

I wanna play tag using all of Lumiose City as the
bounds! Whaddya say?!

Maybe Pokémon are also gathering here in
Lumiose to decide who’s the strongest?

An increase in wild Pokémon...and Mega Stones
yet to be discovered...

A graveyard is really not so different from a park.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s probably a fine place to relax a bit as long as
you keep an eye out for wild Pokémon attacks.

You can spend time with the spirits of departed
Pokémon and people at graveyards.

With so many Pokémon about, I suppose the
people at rest here mustn’t feel lonely.

Here, I can converse with those
whose memories live on in me.

For some reason, visiting graveyards perks me
right up...which is SO out of character for me!

There are some Pokémon that make their habitat
in graveyards.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Can’t say I know what they like so much about
this kind of atmosphere.

How do they know which move
to use just by hearing the name?

If Pokémon make a mess in the
city, do they have to clean it up?

It’s so satisfying smashing a
bunch of Mega Crystals in a row!

It really bugs me how some people
are bugged by Pokémon smells.

I’ve been taking food into the wild zones to feed
the Pokémon there.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I don’t want them to have to steal from people.

I happen to be with the Pokédex Research
Society. If I could write an entry for Whirlipede...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“They are often seen stationary because they are
preserving their energy for Evolution. But upon<U+0010><U+0001>븀
spotting prey, they will spin furiously toward the<U+0010><U+0001>븀
prey to do battle.” Yes, that’s what I’d write.

My five different colored Flabébé are what get me
through the day. I wonder if they feel the same...

What do alphas eat
to get so darn big?

Have you noticed how really big
Mega Crystals form on rooftops?

I know my Pokémon love me
because they stay by my side.

It’s best not to assume
things that are unsaid.

What kinda place d’you think Pokémon like to
live in?

I guess someplace where they have enough to
eat, a safe place to sleep...and people nearby?

I actually like those Hotel Z promo
videos, but no one else seems to...

Today I’ve gotta work with the guy
I battled in last night’s Royale?!

Don’t you feel awfully low when a party ends?
The cure for that is to hold another party!

Everything that lives must die. It’s an immutable
rule—and straying from it can only bring pain.

You see that? Those Pokémon way up in the sky
have been watching us this whole time!

M-maybe...they think this is their territory, and
we’re encroaching on it?

Don’t you think we should just let the Pokémon
run free here in the plazas? I mean, why not?

If you go to all five plazas,
something good happens!

That sounds
totally bogus.

I guess you’ll register
more travel spots...

What do people mean when they say they want to
live with Pokémon? After all, people are so weak!

You can get around faster if you cut straight
through the plaza.

I’m here to observe wild
Pokémon in the plaza!

Wild Pokémon are kind of scary,
but I still want to see ’em up close.

There’s no way anyone could
have a bad time with Pokémon!

It’s all the same, whether I’m
having a good time or bad.

The more you run, the closer
you get to your final goal.

Someone I know told me that if you catch all the
Pokémon that appear in that wild zone once,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
then some outrageous Pokémon will appear.

They just have to be strong enough to battle at
your side reliably.

Well, there’s certainly no Pokémon out there
strong enough to be truly invincible.

What’s it mean for a
Pokémon to be strong?

How strong a partner would
I need to really feel safe?

If it’s way too strong,
it won’t listen to you.

Lumiose is a constant delight.
It never stops changing, does it?

What kind of Pokémon should I get for my first
partner?

You shouldn’t listen to other people’s ideas. Fate
will lead you to the right Pokémon.

I wonder how many Pokémon
there are living in Lumiose?

No one ever truly knows
what the future will bring.

Pokémon sure have it good.
I wish I could use moves too.

Oh, you know how it is! Here in
Lumiose we just love to gab!

Looks like I’m going to lose
another whole day chatting.

Part of our duty is cleaning up
damage from wild Pokémon.

I started raising a Venipede of my own because I
wanna be as cool as Corbeau someday!

I wonder if my sweet Furfrou should go for a
La Reine Trim next time?

Getting slapped with Buneary’s ears stings so bad
it’ll make you cry.

When someone springs a battle on you in the Z-A
Royale, it’s so surprising you freeze up for a sec!

I’ve got an autograph from the famous Rhyhorn
racer Grace!

Know how you seem to see couriers that look like
me all over the place? It’s actually always just me!

I came all the way to Lumiose,
so tell me where the locals eat!

But I don’t want my favorite spots
to all get overrun by tourists...

I wonder what would happen if every Trainer in
Lumiose sent out their Pokémon at once.

Boy, if I could get away with it, I’d love to go
racing down this street on a Rhyhorn...

I wonder if Pokémon also feel more at ease if their
Trainers stay close to them in battle...

I’m a member of the Pokédex Research Society. If
I could do my own entry for Fletchinder, I’d say...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“It scatters sparks from its beak to set grass
aflame. When bug Pokémon come leaping out<U+0010><U+0001>븀
in a panic, it swoops down upon them.”

I used to be able to pick up all kinds of part-time
work at Hotel Richissime.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Taking room service orders, making beds, finding
lost items... It was tough!

Remember, my young friend:
comparison is the thief of joy.

I can feel my Pokémon jostling in
their balls when it’s time to battle!

I can’t afford a stay at Richissime,
but I can take a selfie in front of it!

Knowing how to dodge
incoming attacks is vital!

When a Pokémon uses Dig, how
does it know where to surface?

I saw a Pokémon with glowing eyes when I went
up to the rooftops. I was out of there like a shot!

I imagine it’s the Pokémon themselves who feel
most unnerved by being here in our city.

Whenever I find people laid out by wild Pokémon,
I haul ’em over to a nearby Pokémon Center.

What a broad street! So how about
giving me some breathing space?

I wanna see Pokémon
all playing together!

Anybody else remember using
Pidgey Mail way back when?

I love my old apartment, but
I’d love an elevator even more...

They say the portions are as small as they are so
that you can focus on the flavors. But I just feel<U+0010><U+0001>븀
like I’m getting ripped off!

Oh, just let it go already, would you! We’ll find a
shop that has great flavor and great portions!

I couldn’t sleep a wink with
Spewpa snoring away all night!

I’m nothing like the furisode
girls you might find in Johto.

I wanna try a Poké Puff too!
After all, Pokémon love them!

The Lumiose Museum is doing a
special exhibition about Hisui!

Just seeing the Lumiose Museum
from the outside is enough for me!

Come on, even if we don’t get the
art, we should at least go inside!

I requested permission to sketch a
copy of “Golurk and the Knight.”

Roselia’s blooms give off an aroma with a lovely
relaxing effect.

That curved roof on the museum... Am I the only
one who thinks it just looks like a giant slide?

I know my Rotom Phone should catch me, but I’m
still too scared to cross that narrow scaffolding...

Pokémon learned a new move?
Go ahead and give it a try!

I just want to beat that Trainer and
his darn Pokémon before I go.

The Lumiose Society of Battle Connoisseurs...
Quite intimidating to approach, aren’t they?

You should frequently take stock of the moves
available for your Pokémon to use.

I just like to wander the streets
and leave my office far behind.

If Pokémon do my work for me,
then do they get my salary?

Whatever people say, the SBC isn’t just some rich
kid club—we’re here to make Lumiose better!

Lady Jacinthe’s grand aspiration is a beautiful
harmony between people and Pokémon.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
She takes on the mantle of leader only so she can
help guide the city toward a better future.

There’s nothing I enjoy more than
partying with my Pokémon party!

Lady Jacinthe scolds us terribly if
we lose due to careless blunders.

Lebanne must always
have her hands full...

I’ve heard some people say Lady Jacinthe wants
to have all the Clefable for herself!

The holo-tech they use to enclose
wild zones is really something.

The SBC Trainers are frightfully strong, even if it’s
thanks to constantly fighting among themselves.

If we have to, my Pokémon and
me will protect my grandma!

Just like parents, Trainers mustn’t
stifle their Pokémon’s freedom.

I’ve memorized a bunch
of people’s names! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
